---
title: "Internal diagnostics content"
output: latex_fragment
params:
  study_id: "sma-2026"
  backend: "ss3"
  study_label: ""
  assessment_id: ""
  model_class: "SS3"
  ss_base: ""
  assessment_base: ""
  data_dir: ""
  scenarios: !expr c(
    "Scenario_1/Sc1_Base",
    "Scenario_2/Scn02_base",
    "Scenario_3/Sc3_Base"
  )
  reference_scenario: "Scenario_1/Sc1_Base"
  retro_scenarios: !expr c("Scenario_2/Scn02_base", "Scenario_3/Sc3_Base")
  scenario_register: !expr data.frame(id = character(0), label = character(0), purpose = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  capabilities: !expr list()
  jobs: !expr list()
  paper_figures: !expr character(0)
  profile_import_from: null
  profile_scenario: "Scenario_1/Sc1_Base"
  cv_scenario: "Scenario_1/Sc1_Base"
  appendix_dir: ""
  project_dir: ""
  ss_version: ""
  pe_ss3_sma_dir: ""
  run_code: true
  launch_profiles: false
  strict_errors: true
---

<!--
Required R packages (internal diagnostics):

  tier       package    role
  --------   ---------  --------------------------------------------------
  core       knitr      knit template; format LaTeX tables
  run_code   r4ss       read SS3 output; summarise convergence
  run_code   sstruth    curveSS, diagSS, ssU, ssLen, ssRunSummary, plot* diagnostics
  run_code   diags      diagsFn via sstruth::ssU for CPUE summaries
  run_code   ggplot2    diagnostic figures
  run_code   reshape2   data reshaping for plots
  run_code   ss3diags   SSrunstest, ssruns_sig3; CPUE runs-test plots with 3-sigma limits
  planned    FLRebuild  fallback curveSS if sstruth unavailable
  planned    ss3om      fallback readFLSss3 if readTruth unavailable

Source material:
  - sstruth/R/ss-diags.R, ss-u.R, ss-lencomp.R, ss-PE.R, pseudodataPipeline.R
  - pe-ss3-sma/PE-sma-results.Rmd (curveSS, readFLSss3)
  - ss-ll/Rmd/hessianProfile.Rmd (likelihood profiles)
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(file.path(params$appendix_dir, "R", "appendix-utils.R"))
cfg <- resolve_appendix_params(params)
load_appendix_helpers(cfg)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.path = file.path(cfg$appendix_dir, "figs", "internal", "internal-"),
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 200
)

dir.create(file.path(cfg$appendix_dir, "figs", "internal"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(cfg$appendix_dir, "tables", "internal"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = TRUE)

paths <- scenario_paths(cfg)
paths_ok <- paths[dir.exists(paths)]
do_run <- isTRUE(cfg$run_code) && length(paths_ok) > 0L
if (do_run) {
  require_ok(length(paths_ok) > 0L, "No SS3 scenario directories found under ss_base", cfg)
}
ref_rep <- if (do_run) assessment_reference_report(cfg) else NULL
st <- if (do_run) load_assessment_internal(cfg, reference_path(cfg)) else NULL
ss3 <- if (do_run) load_assessment_case_study(cfg) else NULL
if (do_run) {
  require_ok(!is.null(ref_rep), "Reference SS3 report", cfg)
  require_ok(!is.null(ss3$pe), "SS3 process-error load (ss3$pe)", cfg)
}

if (do_run && isTRUE(cfg$launch_profiles) && !profile_runs_complete(cfg)) {
  launch_likelihood_profiles(cfg, background = TRUE)
}
prof <- if (do_run) collect_likelihood_profiles(cfg) else NULL
```

```{r write-libraries, include=FALSE}
internal_libraries <- data.frame(
  package = c(
    "knitr", "r4ss", "sstruth", "diags", "ggplot2", "reshape2", "ss3diags", "FLRebuild", "ss3om"
  ),
  role = c(
    "Knit template; format LaTeX tables",
    "Read SS3 output; summarise convergence and likelihood components",
    "curveSS, diagSS, ssU, ssLen, ssRunSummary, residual plots",
    "CPUE diagnostic summaries via sstruth::ssU",
    "Likelihood, residual, and recruitment-deviation figures",
    "Data reshaping for diagnostic plots",
    "SSrunstest and ssruns_sig3; CPUE runs-test plots with 3-sigma limits",
    "Fallback curveSS if sstruth unavailable",
    "Fallback readFLSss3 via readTruth (optional)"
  ),
  tier = c(
    "core", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code", "run_code",
    "run_code", "planned", "planned"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write_libraries(cfg, "internal", internal_libraries)
```

```{r write-inputs, include=FALSE}
pkg_versions <- c(
  R = paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
  r4ss = if (requireNamespace("r4ss", quietly = TRUE)) as.character(utils::packageVersion("r4ss")) else "not installed",
  ss3diags = if (requireNamespace("ss3diags", quietly = TRUE)) as.character(utils::packageVersion("ss3diags")) else "not installed",
  sstruth = if (requireNamespace("sstruth", quietly = TRUE)) as.character(utils::packageVersion("sstruth")) else "not installed",
  diags = if (requireNamespace("diags", quietly = TRUE)) as.character(utils::packageVersion("diags")) else "not installed",
  FLRebuild = if (requireNamespace("FLRebuild", quietly = TRUE)) as.character(utils::packageVersion("FLRebuild")) else "not installed",
  ss3om = if (requireNamespace("ss3om", quietly = TRUE)) as.character(utils::packageVersion("ss3om")) else "not installed"
)

inputs <- data.frame(
  item = c(
    "Assessment ID",
    "Model class",
    "SS base directory",
    "Scenarios",
    "Reference scenario",
    "SS version",
    "R version",
    "r4ss",
    "ss3diags",
    "sstruth",
    "diags",
    "FLRebuild",
    "ss3om",
    "Run code"
  ),
  value = c(
    cfg$assessment_id,
    cfg$model_class,
    cfg$ss_base,
    paste(cfg$scenarios, collapse = ", "),
    cfg$reference_scenario,
    cfg$ss_version,
    pkg_versions[["R"]],
    pkg_versions[["r4ss"]],
    pkg_versions[["ss3diags"]],
    pkg_versions[["sstruth"]],
    pkg_versions[["diags"]],
    pkg_versions[["FLRebuild"]],
    pkg_versions[["ss3om"]],
    as.character(isTRUE(cfg$run_code))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write_content(
  cfg,
  "internal/inputs.tex",
  c(
    kable_fragment(inputs, caption = "Internal diagnostics inputs.", label = "tab:internal-inputs"),
    ""
  )
)
```

```{r write-checks, include=FALSE}
checks_lines <- c("% Internal diagnostic checks.", "")

if (do_run) {
  conv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(paths_ok, summarise_ss3_run))
  checks_lines <- c(
    checks_lines,
    kable_fragment(
      conv,
      caption = "Convergence and Hessian summary by scenario.",
      label = "tab:internal-convergence"
    ),
    ""
  )
}

if (!is.null(ref_rep)) {
  ll_comp <- likelihood_components_table(ref_rep)
  if (!is.null(ll_comp) && NROW(ll_comp)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        ll_comp,
        caption = "Likelihood components for the reference scenario.",
        label = "tab:internal-ll-components"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }

  near_bounds <- parameters_near_bounds_table(ref_rep)
  if (!is.null(near_bounds) && NROW(near_bounds)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        near_bounds,
        caption = "Estimated parameters within 2 percent of bounds (reference scenario).",
        label = "tab:internal-near-bounds"
      ),
      ""
    )
  } else {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      "% No estimated parameters within 2 percent of bounds (reference scenario).",
      ""
    )
  }

  advice_pars <- advice_parameters_table(ref_rep)
  if (!is.null(advice_pars) && NROW(advice_pars)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        advice_pars,
        caption = "Advice-relevant parameters and asymptotic standard errors (reference scenario).",
        label = "tab:internal-advice-pars"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }

  comp_ess <- if (!is.null(st) && !is.null(st$ss_len) && NROW(st$ss_len$summary)) {
    st$ss_len$summary
  } else {
    composition_ess_table(ref_rep)
  }
  if (!is.null(comp_ess) && NROW(comp_ess)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        comp_ess,
        caption = "Length-composition effective sample size summary by fleet (sstruth::ssLen).",
        label = "tab:internal-comp-ess"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(st)) {
    ssu_sum <- ssu_fleet_summary(st$ssu)
    if (is.null(ssu_sum) || !NROW(ssu_sum)) {
      ssu_sum <- diag_fleet_summary(st$diag)
    }
    if (!is.null(ssu_sum) && NROW(ssu_sum)) {
      checks_lines <- c(
        checks_lines,
        kable_fragment(
          ssu_sum,
          caption = "CPUE residual summary by fleet (sstruth::diagSS / ssU).",
          label = "tab:internal-ssu-summary"
        ),
        ""
      )
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(st) && !is.null(st$run) && NROW(st$run$run_notes)) {
    notes <- paste0(st$run$run_notes$type, ": ", st$run$run_notes$message)
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      "% SS3 run notes from sstruth::ssRunSummary:",
      paste0("% ", notes),
      ""
    )
  }

  idx_tune <- index_tuning_table(ref_rep)
  if (!is.null(idx_tune) && NROW(idx_tune)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        idx_tune,
        caption = "Index variance tuning and RMSE by CPUE fleet.",
        label = "tab:internal-index-tuning"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }

  runs_tbl <- cpue_runstest_table(ref_rep)
  if (!is.null(runs_tbl) && NROW(runs_tbl)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        runs_tbl,
        caption = "CPUE residual runs-test summary by fleet (ss3diags::SSrunstest).",
        label = "tab:internal-runs-test"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(st) && !is.null(st$diag) && NROW(st$diag)) {
    qic_tbl <- cpue_runs_qic_table(
      st$diag,
      scenario = gsub("Scenario-", "Scenario ", basename(reference_path(cfg)))
    )
    if (!is.null(qic_tbl) && NROW(qic_tbl)) {
      checks_lines <- c(
        checks_lines,
        kable_fragment(
          qic_tbl,
          caption = "CPUE residual individual-chart runs tests by fleet (crossings and longest-run criteria).",
          label = "tab:internal-runs-qic"
        ),
        ""
      )
    }
  }

  rec_proc <- recruitment_process_table(ref_rep)
  if (!is.null(rec_proc$sigma_R)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        rec_proc$sigma_R,
        caption = "Recruitment deviation summary statistics from SS3 report.",
        label = "tab:internal-rec-sigma"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }
  if (!is.null(rec_proc$rmse)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        rec_proc$rmse,
        caption = "Recruitment-deviation RMSE and Durbin-Watson diagnostics.",
        label = "tab:internal-rec-rmse"
      ),
      ""
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(prof) && !is.null(prof$manifest) && NROW(prof$manifest)) {
    checks_lines <- c(
      checks_lines,
      kable_fragment(
        prof$manifest,
        caption = "Likelihood-profile SS3 run manifest (M $\\times$ SR\\_surv\\_Beta grid).",
        label = "tab:internal-profile-manifest"
      ),
      ""
    )
  } else {
    pstatus <- read_profile_status(cfg)
    if (!is.null(pstatus)) {
      checks_lines <- c(
        checks_lines,
        paste0("% Likelihood profile job status: ", pstatus$status,
               if (!is.null(pstatus$updated)) paste0(" (", pstatus$updated, ")") else ""),
        paste0("% Results directory: ", profile_root(cfg)),
        paste0("% Launch background job: launch_likelihood_profiles(cfg, background = TRUE)"),
        paste0("% Or: Rscript appendices/R/run-likelihood-profiles.R --appendix-dir ",
               cfg$appendix_dir, " --scenario ", cfg$reference_scenario, " --all"),
        ""
      )
    } else {
      checks_lines <- c(
        checks_lines,
        "% Likelihood profiles not yet available.",
        paste0("% Run: Rscript appendices/R/run-likelihood-profiles.R --appendix-dir ",
               cfg$appendix_dir, " --scenario ", cfg$reference_scenario, " --all"),
        "% Or set launch_profiles = TRUE when rendering to queue a background job.",
        ""
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  checks_lines <- c(
    checks_lines,
    "% Set run_code = TRUE when SS3 directories are available.",
    ""
  )
}

write_content(cfg, "internal/checks.tex", checks_lines)
```

```{r write-output, include=FALSE}
output_lines <- c(
  "% Internal diagnostic figures and tables.",
  ""
)

if (!is.null(ss3) && !is.null(ss3$pe)) {
  ts_fig <- save_appendix_figure(
    cfg,
    plot_pe_ts(ss3$pe),
    strand = "internal",
    filename = "ss3-ts.png",
    width = 8,
    height = 8
  )
  if (!is.null(ts_fig) && file.exists(ts_fig)) {
    output_lines <- c(
      output_lines,
      figure_fragment(
        cfg,
        ts_fig,
        caption = "SS3 scenario time series relative to MSY reference points (from curveSS).",
        label = "fig:internal-ss3-ts",
        width = 0.92
      ),
      ""
    )
  }

  phase_fig <- save_appendix_figure(
    cfg,
    plot_pe_phase(ss3$pe),
    strand = "internal",
    filename = "ss3-pe-phase.png",
    width = 9,
    height = 4
  )
  if (!is.null(phase_fig) && file.exists(phase_fig)) {
    output_lines <- c(
      output_lines,
      figure_fragment(
        cfg,
        phase_fig,
        caption = "Empirical production and curveSS yield curve versus spawning stock biomass.",
        label = "fig:internal-ss3-pe-phase",
        width = 0.92
      ),
      ""
    )
  }

  save_curve_ss_paper_figures(cfg, ss3$pe)
}

if (!is.null(ref_rep)) {
  fig_specs <- list()

  if (!is.null(st) && !is.null(st$diag) && NROW(st$diag) &&
      requireNamespace("sstruth", quietly = TRUE)) {
    fig_specs <- c(
      fig_specs,
      list(
        list(
          plot = plot_index_fit(st$diag),
          file = "cpue-fit.png",
          caption = "Observed and expected CPUE indices (sstruth::diagSS).",
          label = "fig:internal-cpue-fit",
          width = 9,
          height = 5,
          fig_width = 0.92
        ),
        list(
          plot = backend_plot_cpue_residuals(cfg, st$diag),
          file = "cpue-residuals.png",
          caption = "CPUE residuals by fleet (sstruth::plotResiduals).",
          label = "fig:internal-cpue-residuals",
          width = 9,
          height = 6,
          fig_width = 0.92
        ),
        list(
          plot = backend_plot_cpue_std_residuals(cfg, st$diag),
          file = "cpue-std-residuals.png",
          caption = "Standardised CPUE residuals (sstruth::plotStdResiduals).",
          label = "fig:internal-cpue-std-residuals",
          width = 9,
          height = 6,
          fig_width = 0.92
        ),
        list(
          plot = plot_cpue_runs_qic(
            if (!is.null(st) && !is.null(st$diag)) {
              st$diag
            } else {
              backend_diag_ss(cfg, reference_path(cfg))
            },
            scenario = gsub("Scenario-", "Scenario ", basename(reference_path(cfg)))
          ),
          file = "cpue-runs-test.png",
          caption = "CPUE residual runs tests by fleet (individual-chart criteria; cf. figures.Rmd jara-runs).",
          label = "fig:internal-cpue-runs",
          width = 10,
          height = 8,
          fig_width = 0.95
        ),
        list(
          plot = plot_cpue_runstest(ref_rep),
          file = "cpue-runs-sig3.png",
          caption = "CPUE residual runs tests with 3-sigma limits (ss3diags::SSrunstest).",
          label = "fig:internal-cpue-runs-sig3",
          width = 12,
          height = 10,
          fig_width = 0.95
        )
      )
    )
  } else {
    fig_specs <- c(
      fig_specs,
      list(
        list(
          plot = plot_cpue_fit(ref_rep),
          file = "cpue-fit.png",
          caption = "Observed and expected CPUE indices (reference scenario).",
          label = "fig:internal-cpue-fit",
          width = 9,
          height = 5,
          fig_width = 0.92
        ),
        list(
          plot = plot_cpue_residuals(ref_rep),
          file = "cpue-residuals.png",
          caption = "CPUE residuals by fleet (reference scenario).",
          label = "fig:internal-cpue-residuals",
          width = 9,
          height = 6,
          fig_width = 0.92
        ),
        list(
          plot = plot_cpue_runs_qic(
            if (!is.null(st) && !is.null(st$diag)) {
              st$diag
            } else {
              backend_diag_ss(cfg, reference_path(cfg))
            },
            scenario = gsub("Scenario-", "Scenario ", basename(reference_path(cfg)))
          ),
          file = "cpue-runs-test.png",
          caption = "CPUE residual runs tests by fleet (individual-chart criteria; cf. figures.Rmd jara-runs).",
          label = "fig:internal-cpue-runs",
          width = 10,
          height = 8,
          fig_width = 0.95
        ),
        list(
          plot = plot_cpue_runstest(ref_rep),
          file = "cpue-runs-sig3.png",
          caption = "CPUE residual runs tests with 3-sigma limits (ss3diags::SSrunstest).",
          label = "fig:internal-cpue-runs-sig3",
          width = 12,
          height = 10,
          fig_width = 0.95
        )
      )
    )
  }

  fig_specs <- c(
    fig_specs,
    list(
      list(
        plot = plot_likelihood_components(ref_rep),
        file = "ll-components.png",
        caption = "Likelihood components for the reference scenario.",
        label = "fig:internal-ll-components",
        width = 8,
        height = 6,
        fig_width = 0.88
      ),
      list(
        plot = plot_recruitment_deviations(ref_rep),
        file = "rec-devs.png",
        caption = "Recruitment deviations for the reference scenario.",
        label = "fig:internal-rec-devs",
        width = 8,
        height = 4,
        fig_width = 0.92
      ),
      list(
        plot = if (
          !is.null(st) && !is.null(st$ss_len) && !is.null(st$ss_len$fit) &&
            any(st$ss_len$fit$Fleet == 1L)
        ) {
          plot_length_comp_from_sslen(st$ss_len, fleet = 1L)
        } else {
          plot_length_comp_residuals(ref_rep, fleet = 1L)
        },
        file = "len-comp-residual-f1.png",
        caption = "Length-composition residuals, fleet 1 (sstruth::ssLen when available).",
        label = "fig:internal-len-comp-residual",
        width = 8,
        height = 4,
        fig_width = 0.92
      )
    )
  )

  for (item in fig_specs) {
    fig_path <- save_appendix_figure(
      cfg,
      item$plot,
      strand = "internal",
      filename = item$file,
      width = item$width,
      height = item$height
    )
    output_lines <- append_figure_tex(
      cfg,
      output_lines,
      fig_path,
      item$caption,
      item$label,
      width = item$fig_width
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(prof)) {
    prof_pe <- load_profile_pe(cfg, prof, maxY = 2.5)
    prof_grid <- profile_grid_from_cfg(cfg)
    m_vals <- prof_grid$M
    if (is.null(m_vals) || !length(m_vals)) {
      m_vals <- seq(0.5, 1.5, 0.25)
    }
    pfunc_profile <- if (!is.null(prof_pe)) {
      pr_opts <- production_plot_opts(cfg, "profile")
      save_appendix_figure(
        cfg,
        plot_production_functions(
          prof_pe,
          M_filter = m_vals,
          title = "Production function (M $\\times$ SR\\_surv\\_Beta profile grid)",
          show_trajectories = pr_opts$show_trajectories,
          xlim = pr_opts$xlim,
          ylim = pr_opts$ylim,
          trajectory_yield_scale = pr_opts$trajectory_yield_scale
        ),
        strand = "internal",
        filename = "production-functions-profile.png",
        width = 9,
        height = 6
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
    if (!is.null(pfunc_profile) && file.exists(pfunc_profile)) {
      output_lines <- append_figure_tex(
        cfg,
        output_lines,
        pfunc_profile,
        "Production functions over the M $\\times$ SR\\_surv\\_Beta likelihood-profile grid (curveSS; historical SSB--yield trajectory).",
        "fig:internal-production-functions-profile",
        width = 0.95
      )
    }
    prof_figs <- list(
      list(
        plot = plot_likelihood_profile_total(prof),
        file = "ll-profile-total.png",
        caption = "Total log-likelihood profile over M and SR\\_surv\\_Beta fixed parameters.",
        label = "fig:internal-ll-profile-total",
        width = 8,
        height = 5,
        fig_width = 0.88
      ),
      list(
        plot = plot_likelihood_profile_components(prof),
        file = "ll-profile-components.png",
        caption = "Likelihood-profile components by data source (M $\\times$ SR\\_surv\\_Beta grid).",
        label = "fig:internal-ll-profile-components",
        width = 10,
        height = 12,
        fig_width = 0.95
      )
    )
    for (item in prof_figs) {
      fig_path <- save_appendix_figure(
        cfg,
        item$plot,
        strand = "internal",
        filename = item$file,
        width = item$width,
        height = item$height
      )
      output_lines <- append_figure_tex(
        cfg,
        output_lines,
        fig_path,
        item$caption,
        item$label,
        width = item$fig_width
      )
    }
  }
}

main_figs <- cfg$paper_figures
if (is.null(main_figs) || !length(main_figs)) {
  main_figs <- c("sma-fig-ts-1.png", "sma-fig-pe-phase-1.png")
}

for (fig in main_figs) {
  src <- file.path(cfg$project_dir, "figs", fig)
  if (file.exists(src)) {
    output_lines <- c(
      output_lines,
      figure_fragment(
        cfg,
        src,
        caption = gsub("-", " ", sub("\\.png$", "", fig)),
        label = paste0("fig:internal-", sub("\\.png$", "", fig)),
        width = 0.92
      ),
      ""
    )
  }
}

write_content(cfg, "internal/output.tex", output_lines)
```

```{r write-interpretation, include=FALSE}
write_content(
  cfg,
  "internal/interpretation.tex",
  c(
    "% Case-specific internal interpretation.",
    "% Summarise whether management quantities are informed by data,",
    "% whether likelihood profiles or Hessian checks indicate weak identifiability,",
```
